about: Fraction strips of equal length, each cut into equal parts with its parts shaded as it is said, under a whole bar, with a guide when they come to the same amount: equivalent fractions, comparing fractions, parts of a whole, ratios.

fractions.about: the fractions, one strip each, split by |

whole.about: 0 leaves out the whole bar at the top

guide.about: 0 leaves out the line drawn when all the strips come to the same amount

when.about: moments each strip is shaded; else when its fraction is said, or one after another
